meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观察你的屏幕操作,自动找出重复流程并生成新技能建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 它按你给的时间窗口读取本机 screenpipe 记录的屏幕活动，把重复出现的工作流聚成簇，与仓库已有技能逐一比对，为没被覆盖的模式起草新技能或组合配方，输出到提案文件夹待你审阅。
howto.when: 当你要求分析最近的工作并据此提出新技能时触发。需要本机 screenpipe 守护进程在 3030 端口运行，否则会拒绝运行；不做实时屏幕查询，也不处理一次性问题。

say.text: 分析我过去 4 小时的工作，列出还没被覆盖的流程
先只跑聚类，把要分析的时间线打印给我看
把我反复做的文献筛选流程起草成一个新技能
say.note: 生成草稿，审阅后再 promote

howto.what_en: It reads your local screenpipe screen history for a given time window, clusters repeated workflows, compares them against the repo's existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes into a proposals folder for review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to analyze your recent work and propose skills from it. Requires the screenpipe daemon running locally on port 3030; it refuses to run otherwise, and is not for real-time screen queries.

say_en.text: Analyze my last 4 hours and list workflows not covered yet
Run clustering only and print the timeline for me first
say_en.note: Same as --dry-run: no LLM, just plan.md

say_en.text: Draft a new skill from the literature screening I keep repeating
say_en.note: Creates a draft you promote after review
